tools.name: assert_region
tools.title: Assert region
tools.description: Assert color coverage or change against a baseline. An explicit baseline_frame_id must match x/y/width/height exactly; mismatch returns E_NO_BASELINE instead of comparing different areas.

tools.name: capture_screen
tools.title: Capture screen
tools.description: Capture the virtual display or a region. Returns a PNG plus meta. If save_path is given it is the only output file; otherwise large frames are written to the session artifact directory and returned as a resource link. inline=true (default) embeds small images and a 0.25x preview for large ones. save_path must be an absolute .png under the working directory or temp.

scale.description: Default 0.5 for full screen, 1 for regions.

inline.description: Embed the PNG in the MCP result. Default true for small images.

save_path.description: Absolute .png path under cwd or temp.

tools.name: click
tools.title: Click
tools.description: Click at virtual-desktop coordinates. channel=auto picks UIA element, message or SendInput. Non-client areas (title bar, caption buttons) and popup menus are handled explicitly. keep_foreground=true pauses the focus guard for 30s.

tools.name: click_ref
tools.title: Click element by ref
tools.description: Click a control by element_ref. auto first tries UIA Invoke/Toggle/Select, then message click at the control center; channel=input moves the real cursor. Prefer this over coordinate clicks.

tools.name: find_element
tools.title: Find element
tools.description: Find UI Automation elements and return refs, bounds, state and snapshot_id. Falls back to MSAA when a window exposes no UIA content (Office legacy dialogs). control_type must be a valid UIA control type. role=document_body maps the document text surface.

control_type.description: UIA control type, e.g. Button, Edit, Document.

tools.name: gesture
tools.title: Gesture
tools.description: Composite mouse action: drag, scroll or move. Message mode cannot drag across windows; use channel=input for drags.

tools.name: get_element_text
tools.title: Get text
tools.description: Read text through TextPattern then ValuePattern. Use it to verify what you typed.

tools.name: get_environment
tools.title: Environment
tools.description: Read virtual display, display topology, foreground window and session state. foreground is only reported for tracked windows. ensure=true mounts/heals the virtual display first.

ensure.description: Mount or heal the virtual display before reading state.

tools.name: get_log
tools.title: Get log
tools.description: Read recent in-memory or file log entries, filtered by level/contains. Use it after E_INTERNAL or E_TIMEOUT.

tools.name: get_ui_tree
tools.title: UI tree
tools.description: Read the pruned semantic tree of the tracked window. Nodes carry refs. By default it reuses the current snapshot generation, so existing refs stay valid; pass new_snapshot=true to invalidate old refs.

format.description: text is the compact line format.

new_snapshot.description: Advance the ref generation. Default false: keep existing refs valid.

tools.name: invoke_element
tools.title: Invoke element
tools.description: Invoke a control by ref. auto tries Invoke/Toggle/SelectionItem/ExpandCollapse/Legacy; pattern=default focuses and presses Space/Enter (useful for tree nodes).

tools.name: launch_or_place_app
tools.title: Launch or attach app
tools.description: Start an application or attach to an existing window, move it onto the virtual display and maximize it. Returns pid/hwnd plus any owned dialogs discovered at attach time. Prefer path for a new instance; window only when you intentionally take over a running app.

window.description: Attach by window title. Ignores new_instance.

ensure_document.description: Office only: Ctrl+N when no document.

tools.name: match_visual
tools.title: Match visual
tools.description: Locate pixels on the virtual display: color connected components, single pixel, or PNG template match. template requires 1:1 scale and the same DPI as the capture.

scales.description: Template scales to try, e.g. [0.75,1,1.25]; default [1].

tools.name: press_keys
tools.title: Press keys
tools.description: Send a key combination or a sequence inside one foreground lease. System shortcuts (Win+*, Alt+Tab, Ctrl+Esc and variants) are rejected unless allow_system_keys=true.

tools.name: release_environment
tools.title: Release environment
tools.description: End the debug session: restore window placement, close only processes this session started, optionally remove the virtual display. on_dirty controls unsaved content. Never auto-discards when the result is unknown.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run script
tools.description: Run a temporary PowerShell script with the current user token. Disabled unless the server was started with --allow-script. Output is UTF-8 and truncated to 64KB.

tools.name: set_element_value
tools.title: Set value
tools.description: Write a value by ref. ValuePattern first; allow_keyboard=true falls back to typing. Overwriting non-empty content requires allow_destructive=true.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.title: Snapshot
tools.description: One-call observation: compact semantic tree with refs, tracked windows, owned dialogs, focus and optional screenshot. Each call advances the ref generation: refs from an older snapshot return E_STALE_SNAPSHOT. (find_element/get_ui_tree reuse the current generation.)

include_screenshot.description: Default false; adds a scaled PNG.

include_values.description: Include text/value of text controls. Default true.

tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text
tools.description: Type text into the focused control. auto uses a pattern write, clipboard paste for long text, or SendInput as fallback; verify=true reads back through TextPattern/ValuePattern.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.title: Wait for condition
tools.description: Poll a condition on the server inside one call. type=element|color|window|pixel_diff|visual|text. Read-only: it never holds the write lock, so other observations keep working.
